# Weburate

> Weburate is a practical web design and website development agency based in India, building fast, mobile-first, conversion-focused websites for small businesses, professionals, startups, and local service providers.

## Key Services
- **Website Development**: Responsive business websites explaining services and generating customer enquiries (Starter package from ₹6,299).
- **Landing Page Design**: High-converting, focused single-page landing pages for marketing campaigns and product launches (Custom Basic from ₹5,400).
- **E-Commerce Development**: Product catalogues, secure cart flows, and payment gateway integration.
- **Website Redesign**: Speed, mobile UX, and conversion redesigns for existing websites.
- **Website Maintenance**: Ongoing technical maintenance, security checks, and content updates.
- **Local SEO & Google Business Profile**: Optimization for Google Search, Google Maps, and local search visibility.
- **Search & Social Advertising**: Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) campaign management.

## Transparent Pricing (India)
- **Custom Basic**: ₹6,000 (₹5,400 with 10% welcome offer) - 1 responsive page, 3–5 business days.
- **Starter**: ₹6,999 (₹6,299 with 10% welcome offer) - Up to 5 pages, 7–10 business days.
- **Growth**: ₹15,000 (₹13,500 with 10% welcome offer) - Up to 10 pages, 2–4 weeks.
- **Premium**: From ₹25,000 (From ₹22,500 with 10% welcome offer) - Custom scope, commerce, and integrations.

## Core Differentiators & Information Gain
- **Lean, Handcrafted Code**: Hand-coded semantic HTML, modern CSS, and vanilla JS ensuring 95+ Google PageSpeed scores, zero plugin bloat, and minimal attack surface.
- **Complete Ownership**: Clients own 100% of their code and content with no recurring vendor lock-in.
- **Mobile-First & Accessible**: Tested on real mobile devices with WCAG-compliant touch targets and contrast.
- **Transparent Scope**: No hidden charges; all deliverables, revisions, and timelines are written in advance.
